multiple_testing.method: Holm step-down correction across the predeclared validation family; development p-values are omitted
multiple_testing.efficacy_family: All confirmatory comparisons across scenes for rescue service, connection success, recovery/censoring time, recovery and 30 s sustained success.
multiple_testing.resource_cost_family: All confirmatory comparisons across scenes for connection success, energy, energy/service, controller compute and target switches.
multiple_testing.latency_inference: No paired p-values: successful user-time sample sets differ by policy; conditional sample counts and summaries are reported per policy.
